newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Corimon stock trade to be assessed Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: Corimon stock trade to be assessed Sept 16.

text.p: The Venezuelan Securities Commission (CNV) will decide whether to allow troubled paints and packaging company Corimon SACA shares to resume trading after a shareholders' meeting on September 16, a top CNV official said Thursday.

"After they have sent the agreement (to restructure the company's debts) signed and registered, the CNV will study authorizing (trade of Corimon shares)," CNV President Aida Lamus told a news conference.
The CNV recently extended until September 30 the suspension of Corimon shares from trading on the local stock exchange. The suspension started in February.
The company, which recorded sharp losses last year, recently reached an agreement with creditors to restructure 90 percent of the company's debts of 45 billion bolivars ($95 million).
